# AstryxKbd { #anylumino.AstryxKbd }

```python
AstryxKbd(keys, **props)
```

Render keyboard shortcut text with Astryx styling.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                    | Default    |
|---------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| keys    | str    | Keyboard shortcut text.                                                                                                                                                                        | _required_ |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Kbd props. Useful keys: className and style. The keys argument provides the displayed keyboard shortcut text. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Kbd>. | `{}`       |
